summary_en: 5,013,300 shares acquired (2.80% of S/O) for ¥14,999,793,600 via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-25 at ¥2,992.0/share closing price. Part of authorized ¥20 billion, 10 million share program (August 2026–May 2027).
title_en: Notice Regarding Share Acquisition via Off-Hours Proprietary Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Marui Group announced on 24 August 2026 the execution of a block share repurchase on 25 August 2026 under its authorized self-share acquisition program. The company will acquire 5,013,300 shares (2.80% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for a total of ¥14,999,793,600 via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading at the previous day's closing price of ¥2,992.0 per share. The order will be placed on the morning of 25 August 2026 at 8:45 a.m. JST and is valid only for that session. This block is part of a larger program authorized by the board on 4 August 2026, which permits the acquisition of up to 10 million shares for a maximum of ¥20 billion over the period from 10 August 2026 to 15 May 2027. Results will be disclosed after trading concludes.
